summary: iter-26 full test pass. Backend: 13/13 in test_iter26_regularisation_chain.py. Frontend: all 4 smoke checks pass (Pending Approvals shows new Regularisations tab with count badge + items rendered correctly; HR Settings has the Regularisations tab removed; Check-In LeaveTab has data-testid='mob-leave-type'; Approval Workflows lists Regularisation as a chain type).
what_was_verified: DEFAULT CHAIN: 'Regularisation — Default (1 level)' is seeded on startup with type=regularisation, step level=1 / kind=role / value=hr. All other defaults (leave/reimbursement/transaction/asset_purchase/employee_transfer) still active.

SUBMISSION: POST /api/regularisations attaches chain_id + chain_snapshot, sets current_level=1, renames input 'status' to 'attendance_status' (so chain status 'pending' is not clobbered), enriches center_id from the staff record.

PENDING LIST: Submitted regularisation appears in admin's /api/approvals/pending under request_type='regularisation' with summary.date and a populated description (falls back through reason → 'Regularise X on Y').

FINAL-APPROVE VIA CHAIN: POST /api/approvals/act {request_type:'regularisation', action:'approve'} sets reg.status='approved', current_level=0 AND upserts an attendance row for (staff_id, date) with status=attendance_status, marked_via='regularised', regularised=True, regularisation_id=<rid>.
LEGACY PATCH BACK-COMPAT: PATCH /api/regularisations/{rid}?decision=approved still works — picks attendance_status (or legacy 'status' fallback) when creating the attendance row.
CHAIN CRUD: POST /api/approval-chains + PUT /api/approval-chains/{id} accept type='regularisation' (admin/hr).

LEAVE BALANCE BUGFIX: POST /api/leaves correctly persists leave_type_id on the leave doc. After final-approve via /approvals/act, leave_balances row has used incremented by inclusive day-count (3 for 11-10→11-12) and balance = allocated - used (12-3=9).
EDGE: POST /api/leaves without leave_type_id is still accepted; deduction silently no-ops (no balance row impact).

FRONTEND /pending-approvals: 6 tabs (All / Transactions / Leaves / Reimbursements / Assets / Transfers / Regularisations) — REGULARISATION cards render with date pill + 'HR / Admin' step label and View/Approve/Reject actions.
FRONTEND /hr-settings: only 4 tabs remain (Holidays, Leave Allocation, Geofences, Shifts). Regularisations tab removed.

FRONTEND /check-in LeaveTab: data-testid='mob-leave-type' Select renders with placeholder 'Select type', leave-submit button present and enabled (admin login - no staff link so balance hint not shown, expected).
FRONTEND /approval-workflows: Regularisation listed as a chain type in TYPES list.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/HrSettings.jsx still contains an unused RegularisationsTab() function (lines ~297-330) even though its TabsTrigger + TabsContent are removed. Dead code — safe to delete to reduce bundle size.

Approval description fallback chain reads rec.get('reason') BEFORE the regularisation-specific 'Regularise X on Y' fallback. That's correct behavior (user-typed reason is more informative) but worth noting if main agent expected the static label.
server.py still 6142 lines — repeated recommendation to split into routers; not blocking.
POST /api/approvals/act 'remarks' has min_length=3 — sensible but not documented in OpenAPI; consider adding example in schema.
seed_data_creation: Per-run UUID suffix (RUN=6 chars). Per run: 1 user (TEST_iter26_staff_<RUN>@finance.app role=center_staff), 1 staff linked, 1 leave-type (T<run>), 1 12-day allocation, 2 regularisations (one through chain + one legacy PATCH), 2 leaves (1 with type, 1 without), 1 approval-chain (TEST_iter26 Reg Chain <RUN>, inactive). All TEST_iter26 prefixed for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter-26 fully green. Two important schema gotchas for future testers: (1) /api/approvals/act payload uses 'action' (not 'decision') and requires 'remarks' with min_length=3 chars. (2) /api/leave-balances/allocate body uses 'days' (not 'allocated'). (3) /api/auth/register valid roles do NOT include 'staff' — use 'center_staff'. (4) When admin_session is also used to register a new user, the Set-Cookie from /auth/register OVERWRITES the admin's JWT cookie; always register via a separate requests.Session to keep admin session clean.
